Thanks for the context, Marissa. Quick legal read: 

- Discount: Legal doesn’t sign off on discounts but no legal blocker. Pricing approvals are commercial. 
- SLA: 99.95% is above our standard T&Cs (we typically publish 99.9% for hosted public API). If we consider 99.95%, recommend putting a cap on aggregate financial credits (e.g., 6 months of fees max) and requiring that the customer runs an agreed onboarding readiness checklist. Also prefer a short-term pilot SLA in the contract (90 days) that codifies measurement and escalation.
- Security exceptions: we can accept SOC2 Type II and a redacted pen test as the starting point. Any exception to data controls (e.g., providing raw logs to customer or deviating from our standard retention) needs to be scoped and time-boxed. Recommend conditional approval: legal will sign off if Security posts a short exception memo (1 pager) outlining specific compensating controls.

If Marissa can provide the proposed commercial term sheet (committed ARR, requested discount % and term), I’ll draft recommended clause language for SLA credits and for the security exception (time-boxed and conditional).

-Lauren
